answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the summit accrues. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its trellis never becomes influence. So a meadow of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal ep2vj.
